params.prompt: Same frame, same lens, same light and same colour as the reference image, a few seconds earlier. Keep the exact framing of the reference: the rocket and the tower are exactly the same size and in exactly the same position in the frame, the rocket filling the same height and the same marsh and water strip along the bottom; nothing is zoomed out. the rocket stands completely still on the launch platform beside its tower, with no fire, no steam cloud and no glow at its base; only a thin wisp of white vapour drifts from its side in the heat shimmer. No people. No markings, letters, flags or symbols on the rocket or the tower. Clean image without film grain or borders. No text, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no watermark.
